claim_checks.claim: Five CSV files on figshare (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.28078100): 16,920 wild sampling events; 376,764 assessed wild fish rows; 96 farm facility records; 10,159 monthly farm abundance records; 1,527 zone median load records
claim_checks.extract_quote: There are five files associated with these data, two relating to sea lice observations on wild fish and three relating to sampling for sea lice abundance on Atlantic salmon farms.
claim_checks.note: The numbers match those in the extract.

claim_checks.claim: ~10,000 mean monthly farm abundance estimates from ~100 farms; ~1M wild fish caught but protocol caps mean only ~25% assessed for lice
claim_checks.extract_quote: Around 10,000 mean monthly sea lice estimates are included from almost 100 salmon farms... only roughly 25% of these fish were assessed for sea louse infestation.
claim_checks.note: The numbers and details are consistent with the extract.

claim_checks.claim: 28% of assessed wild fish had any sea louse; ~1% had >10 lice; median wild fish length 47 mm
claim_checks.extract_quote: only 28% of all the wild fish observed were found to have any sea louse infestation, with around 1% of the fish observed having over 10 sea lice.
claim_checks.note: The statistics are directly supported by the extract.

claim_checks.claim: 2015 coast-wide elevated farm motile lice (warm blob) in all zones except 2.3 and 3.1
claim_checks.extract_quote: It seems clear that something unusual in terms of sea lice infestation on farms appears to have occurred in 2015, with all zones other than 2.3 and 3.1... exhibiting unusually high levels of infestation.
claim_checks.note: The claim is consistent with the extract.

claim_checks.claim: Dataset created to counter small-scale/anecdotal claims about BC coast; supports policy analysis of farm closure effects
claim_checks.extract_quote: The long-term dataset reported here can be used to support a clearer and more comprehensive understanding of sea lice infestation patterns along the BC coast over the past two decades.
claim_checks.note: The purpose of the dataset is supported by the extract.
